component.name: OpenFallout
component.summary: Open source engine for Bethesda role playing games

description.p: OpenFallout is an open source game engine that aims to play Fallout 3, Fallout: New Vegas and Tale of Two Wastelands from your own copy of the games.
It is built on OpenMW and is at an early stage: it currently runs The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind, and Fallout gameplay is still being developed.
You will still need the original game data to play OpenFallout.
